en.summary: Digimon Story: Time Stranger is the seventh entry in the Digimon Story subseries, developed by Media.Vision and published by Bandai Namco, which launched on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC on October 3, 2025 before arriving on Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 on July 10, 2026. Following an agent of the organization ADAMAS investigating a catastrophic event that destroys Tokyo and sends the protagonist eight years into the past, it became Bandai Namco's biggest PC JRPG launch, surpassing every Persona and single-player Final Fantasy title's concurrent player count on Steam.

guideSections.title: 3-on-3 Turn-Based Combat & the DigiFarm
guideSections.description: The game retains the series' signature 3-on-3 turn-based combat and Digivolving/De-Digivolving mechanics, adding new "Digimon Personalities" and "Agent Skills" systems, alongside a DigiFarm feature where Digimon not in active battle can passively train, gather resources, and craft items on their own.

guideSections.title: A Standalone Story, 450+ Digimon
guideSections.description: Time Stranger is fully standalone and requires no knowledge of Digimon Story: Cyber Sleuth, featuring a new cast of characters and over 450 collectible Digimon; a story expansion DLC was subsequently announced for a 2027 release.
